original_ai_output.title_zh: 莫桑比克加强对易受洗钱影响行业的监管
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 莫桑比克金融情报办公室（GIFiM）宣布，将加强对房地产、赌场和机动车交易等易被用于洗钱的非金融行业的监管，以避免该国重新被列入金融行动特别工作组（FATF）灰名单。GIFiM官员表示，此前的监管较为随机，今后将改为基于风险的监管方式。报道称，莫桑比克于2025年10月被移出FATF灰名单，并将于2030年再次接受评估。

key_facts.fact: 莫桑比克拟加强对房地产、赌场、机动车交易等非金融行业的反洗钱监管
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Mozambique intends to strengthen the supervision of non-financial sectors vulnerable to money laundering, such as real estate, casinos and the motor vehicle trade

key_facts.fact: 该措施由莫桑比克金融情报办公室（GIFiM）宣布
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The measure was announced by the Financial Intelligence Office of Mozambique (GIFiM)

key_facts.fact: 莫桑比克于2025年10月被移出FATF灰名单，并将于2030年再次接受评估
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the country is seeking to consolidate the progress made since it was removed from the FATF grey list in October 2025

key_facts.fact: GIFiM报告称2021年1月至2025年11月间房地产行业疑似非法资金投资达50.06亿梅蒂卡尔
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: suspected investment of funds from illicit sources in the real estate sector amounting to 5,006 million meticais (€78.2 million), between January 2021 and November 2025

uncertainties: 报道为单一来源（Lusa/Club of Mozambique），尚缺乏交叉验证
房地产行业疑似非法资金规模为GIFiM报告所述，具体认定有待核实
